answer.summary: E2E fails because the app container stops at startup: Flyway finds two migrations with version V6_20261118120000000. The PR adds V6_20261118120000000__Catalog_connector_injector_contracts.java, which collides with the existing V6_20261118120000000__Request_finding_refeed_for_asset_groups_side migration. This is deterministic, so a rerun will fail the same way. Give the new migration a unique version and rerun.

evidence.quote: Caused by: java.lang.IllegalStateException: Duplicate Flyway migration version found: V6_20261118120000000__Request_finding_refeed_for_asset_groups_side.class
